req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

session.description: The session, as it's listed now.

asks.description: What it's asking, not answered yet: its agent's control requests (can_use_tool) as they came.

login.description: Its sign-in, if a turn failed for want of it and that's not been put right yet (ChatLogin): the sign-in card every head draws.

writes.description: Whether the head may change the chat (Agent Management's write, the chat's own first): false, it only reads it, and answers none of its asks.

draft.description: Its draft, as its host keeps it (draft_save); null if none's been written, or the head may only read the chat.

queue.description: Its queue, as its host keeps it (queue); null if nothing's been queued, or the head may only read the chat.
